profile.headline: Lead Software Developer at Charter Communications
profile.summary:
•	10 years of experience in software development involve analysis, design and developing Microsoft.Net applications.
•	Extensive experience in Microsoft technologies includes C#, MVC, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, Web API JQuery, LINQ, XML, Java Script, SSRS, CSS, AngularJS, HTML.
•	Excellence in Object-Oriented Programming skills.
•	Experience Database programming skills in MS SQL Server 2012 and CouchDB.
•	Strong experience in developing Stored Procedures, Functions and Triggers.
•	Having experience of Migrating VB, Classic ASP to .NET Framework.
•	Involved extensively in Unit testing, System testing and bug fixing.
•	Having good problem solving skills and identifying root cause of issues.
•	Experience in using Team Foundation Server (TFS), SVN and Git for source control, task and bugs tracking.
•	Knowledge of IIS and IIS Express configuration.
•	Knowledge of BootStrap and KnockOut JS.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
Integrating Charter, Time Warner Cable and Bright House Network company data in one platform and provide it to collection Agents to recover payment and equipment.

FCM Collection application is developed for getting unpaid customer account and perform payment, equipment returns, disconnect and re-connect related process for Charter Communications.
Responsibilities:
•	Modernising IIS application into containerized application using .NetCore.
•	Handling Onshore and Offshore team.
•	Worked on Active-Active application architecture.
•	Made Jenkins pipeline using git branch commit deployment.
•	Working on PCI compliance application architecture.
•	Upgrading mobile application framework to NativeScript.
•	Developed functionally as transferring data from Oracle to MS SQL Server using SSIS Package.
•	Designed and implemented EBB government program.
•	Creating WebAPI and EAI WFC services for updating status in billing (CSG) application using.
•	Developing Assignment and Nightly Windows Service to sync Biller Data with Application 

Platform: C#, MVC, WabAPI, Ionic, Angular,AngularJs, SSIS, Visual Studio 2019, MS SQL Server 2012, IIS Server, Docker, .NetCore 3.0, Nativescript

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Customised Enterprise Resource Planning System which is cover a wide range of features including Accounting, CRM, Inventory management, Selling, Purchasing, Manufacturing, HR & Payroll, E-Commerce and much more. 

Brillare Science Mobile App: Developed Brillare Goal mobile application. Using this application salesman can see route, goal, achieved goal and send report to management.

Satvaras Mobile App: Developed Satvaras Order mobile application. User can order and manage order using this application. User can see and pay for product from application. User can earn reward using this application. 

Responsibilities:
        
•	Sales person can take order (salon) and track goals (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly).
•	App features the ability to generate reports for managers to see overall progress.
•	Debugged, fixed bugs, and added features enhancements in ERP system.
•	System featured monthly subscription, Reward and Wallet.
•	Backend developed in MVC and powered by MS SQL Server.
•	Managed Project for clients and developed a new Web API.
•	Handled quality assurance.
•	Created reports using SSRS.
•	Collaborated with team using GitHub.
•	Developed the GUI using Ionic and AngulareJS.

Platform: C#, MVC, AngularJs, SSRS, GitHub, Xcode. Unit Test, Visual Studio 2013, MS SQL Server, IIS Server

positions.title: Software and Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed EChem Portal and Aurum PharmaTech.Those applications are a simplified Chemical search engine that enables smooth purchasing experience for buyers. Through EchemPortal application, buyer can find numbers of chemical suppliers. Management people can analyze market and enhance the marketing process. As a security purpose, administrator can restrict to user.
Developed in .NET for intranet and internet applications Backend server powered by SQL (LINQ syntax for Entity Framework and Stored Procedures) and front-end powered by JQuery.
Responsibilities:
•	Analyze requirements and prepare Task Description document to summarize the functional understanding.
•	Designed and implemented the requirement using MVC and Web API. 
•	Developed Import, Export, Data synchronization tools.
•	Designed the Data Layer using EntityFramwork.
•	Configured MolEngine in application and Database.
•	Developed Data synchronization job using Store Procedure and Function in MS SQL Server.
•	Designed frontend using Bootstrap and JQuery.
•	Designed error reporting modal using C#. 
•	Heavy involvement in SQL (SQL Server 2008 and 2012) and MVC with C#.
•	Handled quality assurance using Unit Tests and Coded UI.
•	Deployed application on IIS Server 
•	Collaborated with team using Team Foundation Server (TFS).

Platform: C#, ASP.Net MVC, Web API, EntityFramwork, Bootstrap, JQuery, Store Procedure, SSRS, MS SQL Server,Unit Tests, Coded UI, Visual Studio, MS SQL Server, IIS Server, TFS.

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed SalesGateway (Enterprise Resource Planning System) which  has a Model-View-Controller architecture with metadata modeling tools that add flexibility for users to adapt the software to unique purposes without the need for programming.
Responsibilities:
•	Designed and implemented employee, document, customer, pr	oduct, sales, purchase and payment module using DOJO Toolkit.
•	Developed server side middle layer using Node.js.
•	Developed sales, warehouse, purchase, account related reports using Swing Tool.
•	Designed requirement base document and view in CouchDB.
•	Also handled quality assurance.
•	Collaborated with team using Tortoise SVN.
Platform: Node.js, Dojo, CouchDB, swing, Aptana, Tortoise SVN, Nano.

positions.title: Software Developer  Trainee
positions.description:
Developed Vector Editor which is a desktop application. This application designed to give a machine user interface to user. Using this application user can correct product design and convert AutoCAD file (DXF) to svg file. This application provide drawing tool and properties explore and command module.
Responsibilities:
•	Developed functionally as Loading AUTO CAD files (dxf) using dxfimportnetopensource library.
•	Designed and implemented Drawing Tools module using C#.
•	Developed file conversation module using SVG library.
•	Also handled quality assurance.
